description: Split a source ve-token with an explicit salt and return the deterministic child token ID; the source vote is preserved with reduced weight and the child starts unvoted with the same lock end. Non-destructive: no stake leaves the wallet, no NFT is burned, no vote is cleared, and no fees are discarded.
